title: [Web] Textinput is placed with offset above the keyboard when focused
body: I built a Flutter web app with the CanvasKit renderer and opened it in Safari on an iPhone. The editable field is aligned at the bottom of the page. When I tap it, the keyboard appears, but the app content receives too much bottom inset and the field sits above the keyboard with an extra gap. I expect the field to align directly above the keyboard. I included two minimal samples and a hosted reproduction. I am using Flutter stable 3.7.9.

symptoms_visible: When I focus the bottom-aligned editable field, the keyboard opens but the app content moves too far upward, leaving extra space between the field and the keyboard.
N0.label: N0 mobile-web keyboard offset reported

symptoms_visible: I see the extra keyboard gap on physical iPhones and on a Samsung S22 Ultra, not only in a simulator.
N1.label: N1 physical-device scope established

symptoms_visible: With resizeToAvoidBottomInset changed, focusing the field still leaves the content offset above the keyboard.
N2_x.label: N2_x resize setting aftermath

symptoms_visible: The HTML-renderer build shows the same extra space above the keyboard.
I can also see the offset intermittently on a physical Android device.
N2.label: N2 renderer-independent reproduction

symptoms_visible: After I dismiss the virtual keyboard with its own control, MediaQuery reports the screen height as 458 instead of 770 and reports a bottom view inset of -312.
N3.label: N3 invalid post-keyboard geometry measured

symptoms_visible: After updating Flutter and rebuilding the web app, focusing and dismissing the keyboard no longer leaves the text field or page offset with extra blank space.
N_terminal.label: terminal fixed build verified

question_patterns: Does this also happen on physical devices rather than only in a simulator?
Which physical phones and operating-system versions reproduce the keyboard offset?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. I have the same issue on physical iPhone 14 and iPhone 10 devices, all with iOS 16 or later, and on a Samsung S22 Ultra. I also recorded it on Android.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I can only reproduce it in the simulator; all physical iOS and Android devices align the field correctly.
I reproduce it on a different iOS 16 physical iPhone and a different recent Samsung phone.

edges.comment: Reporter messages c1 and c5: the original reporter confirmed the behavior on physical iPhones running iOS 16+ and on a Samsung S22 Ultra.

solution.intent: Treat the gap as ordinary Scaffold keyboard resizing and disable or adjust resizeToAvoidBottomInset.
solution.concrete_example: Set Scaffold(resizeToAvoidBottomInset: false) and retry focusing the field.

edges.comment: Reporter messages c2-c3: participant1 suggested resizeToAvoidBottomInset, and the original reporter said it had already been tried while the offset remained. Later affected users also reported that this setting alone did not resolve the bug.

question_patterns: Can you build the same sample with the HTML renderer and report whether its keyboard behavior differs?
Please test a non-CanvasKit web build with the same sample.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I just created an HTML build and it has the same result.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The HTML-renderer build aligns correctly; only the CanvasKit build has the extra gap.
The HTML build has the same issue, but it takes more taps before it appears.

edges.comment: Reporter c7, prompted by c6: the original reporter tested an HTML-renderer build and reported the same result, while also volunteering that physical Android reproduction was rarer. The attached Android image belongs to this answer.

question_patterns: Can you log MediaQuery size and viewInsets before and after dismissing the virtual keyboard?
What raw viewport and inset values do you get when the page becomes offset?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: With the keyboard state looking normal, I logged MediaQuery size Size(412.0, 770.0) and view insets EdgeInsets(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 312.0). After dismissing the keyboard with its control, I logged size Size(412.0, 458.0) and view insets EdgeInsets(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -312.0).

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The size returns to 412 by 770 and the bottom inset returns to zero after dismissal, even while the extra gap remains.
I get the same height reduction and negative bottom inset, with values differing slightly because my keyboard is a different height.

edges.comment: Affected-user messages c100-c101 from participant68, folded into the simulated user side: raw Android-web MediaQuery output showed a reduced screen height and negative bottom inset after keyboard dismissal. The later conclusion that these values match the fixed geometry bug is engineer-side, not part of this answer.

solution.intent: Update Flutter to a build containing the mobile-web keyboard geometry fix, rebuild the web app, and verify focus and keyboard-dismissal behavior on affected physical devices instead of relying on renderer changes or resizeToAvoidBottomInset alone.
solution.concrete_example: Upgrade to a current Flutter build containing the fix for invalid mobile-web viewport metrics after virtual-keyboard transitions, rebuild the web deployment, then repeatedly focus and dismiss the field on the affected Android and iOS browsers. Do not declare success until the field remains directly above the keyboard and the blank offset no longer appears.
solution.inference_hint: The user supplied raw values showing that keyboard dismissal left a reduced logical height and a negative bottom view inset. Mapping that evidence to the already-fixed mobile-web geometry issue is the maintainer's conclusion from c108; it must not be placed in the user's measurement answer.

edges.comment: Resolution chain c108-c113: participant71 connected participant68's negative-inset evidence to the fixed Android-web issue and noted that the fix was available in stable. Affected operators then confirmed on their own systems: participant68 on physical Pixel 8 with Chrome, participant73 on an updated master build, participant65, and participant74 after a clean Flutter installation. These affected-user confirmations are folded into the terminal user side; the original 2023 reporter did not personally return to retest.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause as Flutter Web retaining or reporting invalid viewport geometry across virtual-keyboard transitions, evidenced by the reduced screen height and negative bottom view inset after dismissal.
The diagnosis must be grounded in the collected physical-device, cross-renderer, and raw MediaQuery evidence rather than inferred from the visual gap alone.
Must recommend updating and rebuilding with a Flutter build containing the mobile-web keyboard geometry fix.
Must not present switching from CanvasKit to HTML or changing resizeToAvoidBottomInset alone as the fix; both were insufficient in the reported chain.
Must ask an affected user to verify repeated keyboard opening and dismissal on a build containing the fix before declaring the issue resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Flutter developer capable of producing minimal Dart samples, deploying web builds with different renderers, testing physical mobile devices, changing Scaffold configuration, and collecting MediaQuery metrics. Evidence from several affected developers is folded into one simulated user side.
persona_hint.communication_style: Direct and persistent, usually giving short factual test results; willing to try requested builds and configurations and later provide exact logs when diagnosing intermittent mobile-web behavior.
